channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Zverev oo garaacay Fils, kuna dhammaystay wareegga kooxaha ATP Finals isagoon set laga badin
item.description: Alexander Zverev ayaa 19 November magaalada Turin 6-4, 7-6 (8-6) kaga adkaaday Arthur Fils, wuxuuna kaalinta koowaad kaga gudbay kooxdiisa ATP Finals isagoon hal set laga badin.

item.title: Bayern München oo 4-0 kaga adkaatay Austria Wien, kuna dhowaatay wareegga xiga
item.description: Kooxda haweenka ee Bayern München ayaa 19 November magaalada Vienna 4-0 kaga adkaatay Austria Wien, waxayna u dallacday kaalinta saddexaad ee wareegga horyaalka UEFA Women's Champions League.

item.title: Trump oo cafis buuxa siiyay Pete Rose, xiddigii baseball-ka ee dhintay
item.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa 19 November ku dhawaaqay inuu cafis buuxa siiyay Pete Rose, xiddigii hore ee baseball-ka Mareykanka, in ka badan laba sano kaddib geeridiisii.

item.title: Roma oo daqiiqadihii ugu dambeeyay 3-2 kaga adkaatay Benfica, rajada wareegga xigana sii haysata
item.description: Kooxda haweenka ee Roma ayaa 19 November garoonka Estádio da Luz ee Lisbon 3-2 kaga adkaatay Benfica, iyadoo goolka guusha ay dhalisay Sofia Jahnukainen waqtigii dheeraadka ahaa.

item.title: OL Lyonnes oo 2-0 kaga adkaatay Arsenal, una gudubtay wareegga siddeedda Champions League-ka haweenka
item.description: Kooxda haweenka ee OL Lyonnes ayaa 19 November garoonka Meadow Park 2-0 kaga adkaatay Arsenal, waxayna si toos ah ugu gudubtay wareegga siddeedda ee UEFA Women's Champions League iyadoo hal kulan uu weli dhiman yahay.

item.title: Barcelona oo 6-0 ku garaacday Servette, Clàudia Pina oo saddex gool dhalisay
item.description: Kooxda haweenka ee Barcelona ayaa 19 November 6-0 ku garaacday Servette ee Switzerland, waxayna u gudubtay wareegga siddeedda ee UEFA Women's Champions League, iyadoo dib ugu laabatay hoggaanka wareegga horyaalka.

item.title: NFL oo saddex kulan ka joojisay Puka Nacua oo ka tirsan Los Angeles Rams
item.description: Horyaalka kubadda cagta Mareykanka (NFL) ayaa 19 November saddex kulan ka joojiyay Puka Nacua, ciyaaryahanka qaabka wide receiver ee kooxda Los Angeles Rams, kaddib markii lagu helay inuu jebiyay xeerka anshaxa shakhsiga ah ee horyaalka.

item.title: Haiti: Booliska oo sheegay in 34 xubnood oo looga shakisan yahay kooxaha hubaysan lagu dilay howlgal Martissant
item.description: Booliska Qaranka Haiti ayaa sheegay in ugu yaraan 34 qof oo looga shakisan yahay inay ka tirsan yihiin kooxaha burcadda hubaysan lagu dilay howlgal 19 November lagu qaaday xaafadda Martissant ee caasimadda Port-au-Prince.

item.title: FIA oo shaqaalaysiinaysa garsoorayaal joogto ah oo Formula 1 laga bilaabo 2027
item.description: Hay'adda maamusha Formula 1, FIA, ayaa 19 November ku dhawaaqday inay markii ugu horreysay taariikhda isboortiga u magacaabi doonto garsoorayaal tartan (race stewards) oo waqti-buuxa ah, laga bilaabo xilli ciyaareedka 2027.

item.title: Neymar oo caayay taageerayaasha Coritiba kadib guushii Santos ee 1-0
item.description: Xiddigga Brazil Neymar ayaa caayo culus u jeediyay taageerayaasha kooxda Coritiba kadib markii Santos ay 1-0 kaga adkaatay garoonka Couto Pereira tartanka horyaalka Brazil.

item.title: Imaaraadka oo sheegay inuu horay u xiray safaaraddiisa Muqdisho bishii January
item.description: Dowladda Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa war rasmi ah kaga jawaabtay go'aannada Soomaaliya ee 19 November, iyadoo sheegtay inay horay u xirtay safaaraddeedii Muqdisho, diblomaasiyiinteediina ay dalka kala baxday bishii January 2026.

item.title: Senate-ka Mareykanka oo diiday xaddidaadda awoodda dagaalka Trump ee Iran
item.description: Golaha Senate-ka Mareykanka ayaa Khamiistii 19 November 51 cod iyo 48 ku diiday qaraar ku qasbi lahaa Madaxweyne Donald Trump inuu joojiyo dagaalka Iran ama oggolaansho ka helo Congress-ka si uu u sii wado.

item.title: Apollo iyo mulkiilayaasha Man City oo hakiyay qorshe amaah ah oo $2 bilyan ah
item.description: Shirkadda maalgashiga Mareykanka ee Apollo Global Management iyo mulkiilayaasha Manchester City ayaa joojiyay wadahadallo ku saabsanaa amaah dhan qiyaastii $2 bilyan, kaddib markii City lagu helay dambiyo la xiriira xeerarka maaliyadda ee Premier League.

item.title: Paris FC oo waqtigii dheeraadka 2-1 ku garaacday HB Køge, guushii ugu horreysay Champions League-ka
item.description: Kooxda haweenka ee Paris FC ayaa 19 November 2-1 ku garaacday HB Køge ee Denmark, taasoo ah guushii ugu horreysay ee ay ka gaarto 5 kulan oo UEFA Women's Champions League ah.

item.title: Museveni oo ganacsatada shaqada joojiyay ka codsaday inay dib u furaan ganacsiga
item.description: Madaxweynaha Uganda, Yoweri Museveni, ayaa ka codsaday ganacsatada shaqo joojinta ku jira inay dib u furaan ganacsigooda ilaa Talaadada 24 November, marka dowladdu la filayo inay ka jawaabto cabashooyinkooda.

item.title: Somaliland oo sheegtay in Muqdisho aysan awood u lahayn xiriirkeeda dibadda
item.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibedda ee Somaliland ayaa Khamiistii 19 November sheegtay in dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya aysan lahayn awood sharci oo ay ku xaddiddo xiriirka dibadda ee Somaliland.

item.title: Hirshabeelle oo mamnuucday hubka garoonka Ugaas Khaliif kadib xiisadda Beledweyne
item.description: Maamulka Hirshabeelle ayaa Khamiistii 19 November ku amray ciidamada AUSSOM iyo ciidamada qalabka sida in aan hub lala gelin garoonka diyaaradaha Ugaas Khaliif ee Beledweyne, kadib xiisad maalintaas ka dhacday garoonka.

item.title: Mario Frick oo sheegay inuu Aberdeen dib ugu celin doono aasaaska ciyaarta
item.description: Tababaraha cusub ee Aberdeen, Mario Frick, ayaa sheegay in kooxda oo ku jirta halista u dhicidda Scottish Premiership ay hadda u baahan tahay hab fudud oo aasaasi ah si xilli ciyaareedka loo badbaadiyo.

item.title: UEFA oo ganaaxday England heesaha taageerayaasha ee Spain dartood
item.description: UEFA ayaa ganaax dhan 15,000 euro saartay Ururka Kubadda Cagta England, kuna xukuntay mamnuuc hal kulan oo dib loo dhigay oo saaran taageerayaasha safarka, kadib heesihii lagu qaaday kulankii Nations League ee Spain.

item.title: Belichick iyo Kraft oo u gudbay wareegga xiga ee Hall of Fame-ka NFL
item.description: Tababarihii hore ee New England Patriots, Bill Belichick, iyo milkiilaha kooxda, Robert Kraft, ayaa u gudbay heerka xiga ee doorashada Pro Football Hall of Fame ee fasalka 2027, kadib markii sannadkii hore la diiday.

item.title: Drone oo duubay tababarkii ugu horreeyay ee Pochettino ee Man United
item.description: Muuqaal 12 daqiiqo ah oo drone laga duubay tababarkii ugu horreeyay ee Mauricio Pochettino uu Manchester United la qabtay ayaa lagu faafiyay YouTube, ka hor kulanka Liverpool ee Anfield.

item.title: Fernando Torres oo ka hadlay ka tagistiisii Liverpool ee uu Chelsea ugu wareegay
item.description: Weeraryahankii hore ee Spain Fernando Torres ayaa sheegay inuusan ka qoomamoon go'aankii uu 2011 Liverpool uga tagay Chelsea, balse uu ka qoomamoonayo sida uu u maamulay iyo xanuunka uu u geystay taageerayaasha.

item.title: Juventus oo heshiis cusub siisay xiddigga da'da yar Augusto Owusu
item.description: Juventus ayaa si rasmi ah u shaacisay in khadka dhexe ee da'da yar Augusto Sedorf Owusu, oo dhashay 2005, uu saxiixay heshiis cusub oo muddadiisa kooxda ku sii haynaya.

item.title: Doorashada FIFA: UEFA oo warqad cabasho ah u dirtay FIFA, Blatter-na su'aal geliyay xaqa Infantino
item.description: Hoggaanka ururka kubadda cagta Yurub (UEFA) ayaa warqad cabasho ah u diray madaxda FIFA, iyadoo madaxweynihii hore ee FIFA, Sepp Blatter, uu sheegay in Gianni Infantino aanu xaq u lahayn inuu u tartamo muddo afraad, sida ay warbaahinta isboortigu ku warrantay 19 November.

item.title: Manchester United oo mamnuucday 4 taageere oo kubado tennis ku tuuray garoonka kulankii Roma
item.description: Manchester United ayaa garoonka Old Trafford ka mamnuucday afar taageere oo ka qeyb qaatay mudaharaad lagu tuuray kubadaha tennis-ka intii lagu jiray kulankii Champions League-ka ee kooxda la ciyaartay Roma, sida ay warbixinnadu sheegayaan.

item.title: Galmudug oo magacaabay Xeer Ilaaliyaha Guud iyo Garyaqaanka Guud
item.description: Hoggaamiyaha Galmudug, Liibaan Axmed Xasan, ayaa Khamiistii 19 November magacaabay Xeer Ilaaliyaha Guud iyo Garyaqaanka Guud ee dowlad goboleedka.

item.title: Duqeymo AFRICOM iyo dowladda oo lagu bartilmaameedsaday Al-Shabaab 3 goobood
item.description: Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada Mareykanka ee AFRICOM, iyagoo kaashanaya dowladda, ay 13 ilaa 15 November duqeymo cirka ah ka fuliyeen 3 goobood oo Al-Shabaab ku lahayd dalka.

item.title: Mushaharka MLS: Lewandowski iyo Griezmann oo ku biiray Messi liiska ciyaartoyda ugu mushaharka badan
item.description: Ururka ciyaartoyda horyaalka MLS ayaa 19 November soo saaray liiska mushaharka cusub, kaas oo muujinaya in Lionel Messi uu weli yahay ciyaaryahanka ugu mushaharka badan, halka Robert Lewandowski iyo Antoine Griezmann ay galeen kaalimaha sare.

item.title: Jeremie Frimpong oo ku guuleystay abaalmarinta FIFPRO Player Voice ee 2026
item.description: Daafaca Liverpool iyo xulka Netherlands, Jeremie Frimpong, ayaa ku guuleystay abaalmarinta FIFPRO Player Voice Award ee sanadka 2026, taasoo loogu abaalmariyay barnaamijkiisa Pathways ee caawiya ciyaartoyda da'da yar ee ka baxa akadeemiyada kubadda cagta.

item.title: Napoli: Goolhaye Alex Meret oo laf-dhabarta ka jabay tababarka, muddada uu maqnaanayo lama oga
item.description: Kooxda Napoli ayaa 19 November si rasmi ah u sheegtay in goolhayeheeda Alex Meret uu tababarka ku dhaawacmay, baaritaanno lagu sameeyayna ay muujiyeen inuu ka jabay lafta shanaad ee qaybta hoose ee laf-dhabarta.
